subject: Request: short customer advocacy quote to support upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@finoptics.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick favor — 1-2 line quote for renewal materials

Hi Jared,

Hope you're doing well — excited to be moving toward the renewal conversations later this quarter. As we prepare the materials for our renewal and the exec briefing, would you be willing to share a short (1-2 sentence) quote about the tangible outcomes you saw after switching FinOptics' realtime search to Redwood? Something outcome-focused is most helpful (e.g., performance, cost, reliability). If it helps, a sentence like the draft in the attached summary is totally fine to edit.

We can include the quote in a one-page summary and a case-study draft; Connor will share both artifacts. If you prefer, happy to take a quote over the phone and draft it for you.

Appreciate it — this directly helps the renewal and makes it easier for your procurement folks to see value.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: FinOptics_Q3-performance-summary.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@finoptics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick favor — 1-2 line quote for renewal materials

Connor — thanks for the note and the summary. Happy to help. Quick context for the team: the rollout with Redwood cut median query latency from ~250ms to ~90ms for our production traffic, which materially improved UI responsiveness during peak loads. Overall infra spend on inference (tokens + infra) dropped ~28% compared to our prior setup. Both metrics were key in getting internal buy-in for increasing committed capacity.

If you want a pithy quote for collateral, you can use/edit the line below — please send me the final before publishing.

"Redwood reduced our median query latency by more than half and cut inference costs nearly 30%, enabling us to deliver a consistently snappy search experience while lowering operating spend."

Happy for you to attribute to: Jared Cole, VP Engineering, FinOptics.

Jared

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick favor — 1-2 line quote for renewal materials

Laura / Connor — forwarding Jared's response (below). Good quote and permission to attribute to Jared Cole. Two quick asks before we send the final collateral to procurement and the renewal sponsor: 1) can marketing fold his line into a one-paragraph case-study draft (I've attached the redwood-case-study-draft.docx) and 2) Connor — please confirm whether procurement will accept this as a reference (they sometimes ask for a short statement + contact).

Notes for marketing: prioritize the outcomes language (latency and cost), and include a callout with the Q3 performance PDF. Avoid technical deep dives in the public case study — keep it outcome and business-impact oriented.

If we want a 30-second video clip or a signed testimonial, we can ask separately; Jared seemed open but prefers to keep it short for the exec pack. I'll queue this for the renewal binder — want to have final language by Monday so the sales lead can include it in the renewal slide deck.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-case-study-draft.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@finoptics.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized quote and draft case-study — approval to publish?

Hi Jared — thanks again for the clear language. We folded your sentence into a concise one-paragraph case study and pulled a metrics callout into the one-pager (attached). Please confirm we have approval to: 1) publish the one-sentence quote attributed to you and 2) include FinOptics' Q3 performance callout in the public case study. Below is the final line we're proposing — edited only for brevity: 

"Redwood reduced our median query latency by more than half and lowered inference costs by nearly 30%, allowing us to deliver a consistently snappy search experience while reducing operating spend."

If it's okay, we'll also include: 
• Median query latency: 250ms -> 90ms (production traffic)
• Inference cost reduction: ~28% (tokens + infra)

If you'd like any edits or prefer different attribution, let me know and we won't publish until you approve.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — it will make the renewal packet much easier to review with your procurement and ops teams.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
